caveats: This is an intermediate publish while pt-nzzh80jf is still running, not final experiment completion.

The training process produced a 3072-d native-4RC checkpoint, but the old training worktree on disk was later polluted by Wan2.2 extractor edits; this page evaluates with the recovered pure worktree 607b505.
Metrics are training-loss replay on 16 train and 16 test windows; no predictions.pt, RGB overlays, 3D videos, detection F1, PA-MPJPE, or gamma decomposition are included yet.
Full final eval/publish must be rerun after the clean native full-train path is submitted or after pt-nzzh80jf finishes and provenance is explicitly accepted.
